actions_title: Our work in the Paris Region
actions_subtitle: Supporting people today to build a better tomorrow
actions_intro: In the Paris Region, we work every day alongside people facing hardship, providing practical and sustainable solutions.
actions_assistance_description: We provide immediate, tailored assistance to people facing hardship, including access to essential goods, social support and guidance towards appropriate services.
actions_reintegration_description: We support people throughout their social and professional reintegration journey through training, personalised assistance and a network of partners.
actions_homeless_description: We work directly in the field to provide practical and compassionate support to homeless people through outreach, emergency accommodation and guidance towards sustainable solutions.
africa_actions_description: Our delegations also carry out initiatives to combat infectious diseases in West Africa, working alongside local communities.
africa_actions_info: This section will soon be expanded with more information about our work and projects in Africa.
about_hero_subtitle: Beyond assistance: a mission of compassion and hope
about_hero_description_1: We believe that every person deserves to be respected, listened to and supported, whatever their circumstances. Our mission combines practical assistance, emotional support and meaningful human connection.
about_hero_description_2: By considering each person as a whole, we help them rediscover the resources, opportunities and confidence they need to move forward.
about_hero_autonomy_description: To help everyone rebuild their lives.
about_hero_image_alt: Two people supported by FEMAPE-I looking out over the city
about_history_summary: Born from a desire to act against inequality and social exclusion, FEMAPE Initiative supports people who need it most. From France to Burkina Faso, our work has gradually grown around one shared conviction: putting people at the heart of solidarity.
about_history_paragraph_1: FEMAPE Initiative was born at a time when the urgency to act could be felt on every street corner and in every encounter. Founded with the determination to address growing inequality and social exclusion, our organization quickly evolved into a force for change and hope. Every stage of our development has been guided by one mission: to be there where needs are greatest, without ever losing sight of our shared humanity.
about_history_paragraph_2: The expansion of our work beyond France, particularly with the opening of a branch in Burkina Faso, reflects our commitment to providing assistance wherever it is needed, regardless of borders or nationality. This step marked the beginning of our international presence and reflects our vision of solidarity without limits, capable of transcending cultural and geographical barriers to reach every life with the same dedication.
about_history_image_alt: A FEMAPE Initiative volunteer interacting with a child during a community support initiative
about_approach_understand_description: Every situation is unique. We take the time to listen and understand so that we can provide an appropriate response.
about_approach_together_description: We work with local organizations, institutions and people on the ground to combine our skills and expertise.
about_approach_autonomy_description: We adapt our actions to help everyone regain their place in society and build lasting independence.
about_solidarity_description: A donation, your time or simply sharing our cause: every commitment helps build a fairer and more inclusive world.
about_solidarity_image_alt: A FEMAPE Initiative volunteer talking with someone receiving support

programs_hero_intro: At FEMAPE-I, we offer a comprehensive range of services designed to meet the needs of vulnerable people.
programs_hero_goal: Our goal is to provide practical, psychological and social support to those who need it most, with a strong focus on dignity and independence.
programs_hero_support_description: Standing alongside people facing the greatest vulnerability.
programs_hero_listen_description: Building human connections through care and understanding.
programs_hero_rebuild_description: Helping people regain independence, confidence and new perspectives.
programs_hero_image_alt: A support worker assisting a vulnerable person
programs_intro: Discover our programmes designed to meet the needs of vulnerable people and support their personal development. Each programme provides practical and lasting support, placing dignity and independence at the heart of our work.
programs_vulnerable_summary: Personalised support for elderly people, people with disabilities and those facing difficult circumstances.
programs_vulnerable_image_alt: A FEMAPE Initiative volunteer offers a hot drink to a vulnerable person.
programs_vulnerable_description: Our support is designed for people facing vulnerable circumstances, whether they are elderly, living with a disability or experiencing hardship. Recognising that every life journey is unique, we provide a wide range of assistance tailored to individual needs. This includes attentive support at home, where our teams help make everyday life easier and more comfortable through household tasks, meal preparation and medication management. Medical support is also an essential part of our work, including treatment follow-up, coordination with healthcare professionals and the organisation of medical appointments. Beyond practical assistance, we strongly believe in the importance of social connections and community involvement. Our social activities aim to reduce isolation, strengthen support networks and encourage personal fulfilment through workshops, cultural outings and meaningful encounters. At FEMAPE-I, our goal is to ensure that every person receives the attention, respect and care they deserve, helping them live with dignity and peace of mind.
programs_vulnerable_detail_image_alt: A vulnerable person receiving attentive and compassionate support
programs_reintegration_summary: Training and personalised support to help people make a sustainable return to employment and active life.
programs_reintegration_image_alt: A man receiving guidance from an adviser as part of a professional reintegration programme
programs_reintegration_description: In a constantly changing society, the challenges associated with unemployment and professional exclusion require appropriate and effective responses. FEMAPE-I’s reintegration programmes are based on a comprehensive and personalised approach designed to help people who are marginalised or seeking a new direction return to employment and active life. Our programmes include vocational training adapted to the realities of the labour market and covering a variety of sectors and skills. Alongside this, workshops focusing on social and personal development help participants build self-confidence, communicate effectively and strengthen their ability to work as part of a team. Support with job searching is an essential part of our programmes and includes interview preparation, the creation of effective CVs and connections with potential employers. Our goal is to provide a pathway towards financial and social independence by giving each person the tools they need to fulfil their potential and thrive in both their professional and personal lives.
programs_reintegration_detail_image_alt: A person receiving personalised guidance to prepare for a return to employment
programs_psychological_summary: A safe and supportive space to overcome difficulties and regain peace of mind.
programs_psychological_description: Mental well-being is an essential part of quality of life, yet it is still too often overlooked. At FEMAPE-I, we place particular importance on supporting people facing emotional difficulties arising, for example, from stressful life circumstances, loneliness or traumatic experiences. Our services provide a safe and compassionate space where people can express their feelings, concerns and hopes. Through individual sessions led by attentive professionals, we seek to understand and ease the emotional difficulties experienced by those we support. Support groups provide a collective environment where participants can share experiences and build connections with others facing similar situations. Our support is personalised and adapted to each person’s pace and needs, helping them restore their mental and emotional balance and approach life’s challenges constructively. Our ambition is to help every person supported by FEMAPE-I regain the peace of mind, inner strength and well-being they need to move forward.
programs_psychological_detail_image_alt: A professional listening attentively during a psychological support session
programs_homeless_summary: Human connection, compassionate listening and practical assistance for people experiencing homelessness.
programs_homeless_image_alt: Volunteers providing support and comfort to a person experiencing homelessness
programs_homeless_description_1: At FEMAPE Initiative, supporting people experiencing homelessness is a priority. Led by dedicated volunteers, this work gives us the opportunity to meet people living on the streets and offer them a friendly presence, a smile, compassionate listening and something to eat.
programs_homeless_description_2: Faced with the growing number of people experiencing homelessness, whether French citizens or migrants, our priority is to maintain human connection and provide a listening ear. Working alongside other organisations, we also support people on their path towards social reintegration. We provide healthy and varied food, prepared in part from unsold bakery products and through our Socio-Culinary Workshop in partnership with our solidarity grocery store.
programs_homeless_description_3: We also aim to welcome the people we support into a warm and safe environment, particularly on rainy days, with breakfasts served at our grocery store. Our Socio-Culinary Workshop and its solidarity-based, socio-cultural café and snack area play an essential role by providing shelter, companionship and much-needed human warmth during difficult times.
programs_homeless_description_4: All of this is made possible by the selfless commitment of passionate volunteers, as well as by donations and memberships from people who choose to support our work.
programs_homeless_thanks: Thank you all for your support and generosity.
programs_homeless_detail_image_alt: FEMAPE Initiative volunteers reaching out to people experiencing homelessness
programs_donation_description: Your generosity helps us continue our programmes and build a better future for vulnerable people.
